## Steeping

Cold brew uses a coarse grind and cold or room-temperature water. Steep the grounds for 12 to 18 hours, then filter. Steeping longer than 24 hours tends to pull out woody, harsh flavours.

## Concentrate

A 1:8 ratio makes a concentrate that you dilute about one to one with water or milk before drinking. The concentrate keeps for up to two weeks in the fridge.
